shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls; ls src 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; grep -n -i -E "chart|график|line" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json AGENTS.md; ls __agent_eval__; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tr -d ' \n' | grep -o '"[01]\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"' | tail -8; for v in 1.30.0; do :; done; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | tail -30

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 2>&1 | tail -8; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -60; cat get-started.md | head -80; grep -rn -i -E "theme|dark" --include=*.md -l .

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/colors.md | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types; grep -n -i -E "theme|ThemeProvider" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts
